subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + ask: monthly token volume & peak TPS (Hosted API pricing)

Liam - thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so we can put together an accurate hosted-API pricing estimate and pilot plan: 

1) Recap from today
- Use case: in-app assistant + workflow automation for FinTechX customers (support + account insights).
- Model profile: mixture of chat and single-turn completions; avg tokens per request ~200-1300, some longer threads up to ~1k tokens.
- Primary constraint: keep latency sub-300ms for short queries; allow slightly higher for longer context calls.

2) Pricing inputs we need (one-line answers are fine)
- Expected monthly token volume (approx): total tokens/month you expect to send+receive
- Peak TPS (transactions per second) during busy windows: expected requests/sec at peak
- Target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range you're aiming for (helps us recommend quantization/commit levels)

3) Next steps we'll take once we have those numbers
- Draft hosted-API pricing scenarios (on-demand vs committed tiers) and a unit-economics model showing $/1M tokens and estimated monthly bill.
- Propose a 30-day pilot with usage caps and trial credits so you can validate latency and quality.

Attaching a rough pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx and a one-page mutual_action_plan.docx - fill in the volumes line and I'll update numbers.

If it's easier, reply in-line with the three items above. Thanks - Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.docx (doc stub)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@fintechx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@fintechx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: monthly token volume & peak TPS (Hosted API pricing)

Ben - thanks for the summary. Answers below (high-level estimate for planning; we can refine after a week of pilot):

- Expected monthly token volume: approx 150,000,000 tokens/month (150M). This is across all environments (prod+staging); initial prod rollout expected to be ~75% of that in month 1 and grow.
- Peak TPS (requests/sec): peak requests ~60 TPS during business hours (we see short spikes during batch jobs up to ~100 TPS for ~5-10 minutes). Average payload ~250 tokens/request; peak token/sec roughly 15k tokens/sec during sustained peaks.
- Target $/1M tokens / budget range: we're targeting an all-in unit cost of ~$8–$12 per 1M tokens. Monthly budget (initial pilot -> production) is roughly $8k–$20k depending on unit price and SLA.

Other notes:
- Data residency: must be US-only.
- Security: we'll need SOC2 evidence and an IP protection discussion - Sarah will lead that thread.

Happy to do a short call to walk through the pricing spreadsheet later today if that helps.

Thanks - Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, FinTechX
liam@fintechx.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: monthly token volume & peak TPS (Hosted API pricing)

Perfect - thanks for the quick turnaround and the detail, Liam. A few follow-ups and what we'll deliver by EOD tomorrow: 

- We'll build three hosted-API scenarios in the attached spreadsheet: on-demand (no commit), 3-month commit, and 12-month reserved commit. For each we'll show: 
  * estimated $/1M tokens after committed discounts,
  * monthly bill for 150M tokens,
  * expected latency targets at 60 TPS and behavior during 100 TPS short spikes.

- Based on your $8–$12 target, we'll show what kind of commit (if any) is needed to hit $8/1M. Early gut: $8/1M likely requires a modest committed volume or equivalent reserved capacity - we'll quantify.

- Security & compliance: looping Marissa (sales engineer) and Alex (solutions). Marissa will share SOC2 artifacts and Alex will sketch a data-residency and network isolation plan for US-only deployment.

- Next steps: if the numbers look good, propose a 30-day pilot with a $5k credit and a capped test volume (we'll propose caps in the MAP). If you want to book a quick call to review the scenarios, I have availability 3-4pm PT today.

Attaching an updated pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx and the MAP (mutual_action_plan.docx) with placeholders filled from your numbers. Let me know when you want the walkthrough.

Thanks - Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
